With the lab reachable and the browser unable to reach the internet (request guard plus DNS refusal), /documentation listed 62 guides, local search for restore found the backup guide, and reading made no external or API request. After the lab was stopped, the retained standalone copy opened from disk with JavaScript disabled: 12 collections and 62 guides, with every guide's prose. A copy without search.js and inter.woff2 still showed the index and all 62 guides, and a submitted search left the index visible. No http request was made from disk.

With the lab reachable and internet blocked in the browser, the operator audience listed 11 guides. install, backup-and-restore, upgrade and operator-troubleshooting opened, and search worked. The app-served standalone edition searched and downloaded with no external request. pnpm docs:export ran in a clean archive of 3ba23d39 (workingChanges false). The directory and archive were retained outside the worktree and lab with a SHA256SUMS manifest. The pub3 lab was stopped and refused connection. The retained copy opened from disk: 62 guides with and without JavaScript, local search, theme persistence and edition digest 07a63d01. A copy without search.js and inter.woff2 stayed readable. Removing backup-and-restore.html made sha256sum --check fail naming that file, and the crawl found 61 of 62 guides. Copying the file back made the check pass and all 62 guides open.

findings: The DOC-030 edition carries 62 guides (DOC-029: 57). Readers see administrator 53 (47), legal team member 41 (37), Business User 16 (12) and operator 11 (10). Five MCP guides are new.

connect-chatgpt and connect-microsoft-365-copilot show Validation in progress in the index, search results and article header, under the edition's validation-pending publication block. They read normally at 1280px and 320px. No other guide carries the badge.

The Portal Request page no longer shows Help with this page. adc4f954, which is in the pinned app, removed it. help-contexts.json still marks /portal/requests/:number as pilotEntry. Header Help carries portal.request and lists Follow a Request first. The staff Inbox link is still absent, as DOC-029 recorded. The batch owner records this as a note.

The signed-in header and Portal brand re-read GET /api/v1/org/branding on every navigation, including each Help search (2c028604). It is organization chrome, not a record query. The check counts it as a shell request. The batch owner records this as a note.

The served archive differs from the pnpm docs:export archive. Every HTML, CSS, font and license file is identical. Only redirect.js and search.js differ, because the image build bundles the compiler, as in DOC-029. The content digest is the same.
limitations: Agent check only. This is not human proofreading, a human user study, an assistive-technology study or product-owner approval.

The export ran in a git archive of 3ba23d39 with OPENLAW_BUILD_COMMIT and OPENLAW_BUILD_DIRTY=false, the identity the image build uses, because the review worktree held an unrelated README edit. The worktree compile gives the same content digest.
An earlier pass on 1009e131 (lab pub2) failed on untracked compatibility logs and an export link error. 3ba23d39 fixes both. This record covers only pub3.
Internet was blocked inside the browser by a request guard that allowed only the loopback lab and by Chromium DNS refusal. The host itself still had internet access.
The standalone edition ships no completeness checker. The completeness check here is sha256sum --check against a SHA256SUMS manifest written at retention, plus a browser crawl from the index.

The scripts are DOC-029's with these changes: addresses, the guide counts (read from articles.json), the password variable, the branding shell request and the removed Portal Request link. Steps for the validation badge, the served digest and anchor aliases are new. The bundle comes from compileWorkspace({development: true}), because that is what the image compiles.
Real browser zoom was sampled on one guide per reader. Theme and 320px checks used one guide per reader plus the two review guides. The link check covered every guide in the formal reader.

The lab was built from 3ba23d39bdd52894baff7319762ee4a073b1b8be. Before the push, the branch history was rewritten to drop a stray Playwright session file (state-admin.json) committed at the repository root. The distribution commit e85bc4b746dfe6d8adf0ff170fa7695c667fac48 has the same tree apart from that file, so the documentation content and digest are unchanged.
